_comment: Recommended IoT companion apps for security analysis (Android only). Package names verified against Google Play Store listings.

apps.name: Google Home
apps.notes: Primary controller for Google/Nest devices; acts as a Matter hub

apps.name: Amazon Alexa
apps.notes: Controls Amazon Echo family and Matter-certified devices

apps.name: Samsung SmartThings
apps.notes: Samsung IoT hub; supports Matter and Zigbee via SmartThings Station

apps.name: Tuya Smart
apps.notes: Backend platform for hundreds of third-party IoT brands

apps.name: Smart Life (Tuya OEM)
apps.notes: Tuya-powered app rebranded for end consumers; widely deployed

apps.name: Mi Home (Xiaomi Home)
apps.notes: Controls Xiaomi/MIUI ecosystem; Matter bridge via Xiaomi hub

apps.name: Philips Hue
apps.notes: Smart lighting; Hue Bridge exposes Matter endpoint

apps.name: TP-Link Kasa Smart
apps.notes: Kasa range of smart plugs and bulbs; newer devices are Matter-certified

apps.name: TP-Link Tapo
apps.notes: Newer TP-Link brand for cameras, plugs, and hubs

apps.name: eWeLink
apps.notes: Controls SONOFF devices; large install base in DIY IoT community

apps.name: Ring
apps.notes: Video doorbells and security cameras; integrates with Alexa

apps.name: Arlo
apps.notes: Wire-free security camera system

apps.name: EZVIZ
apps.notes: Consumer brand of Hikvision; IP cameras and smart locks

apps.name: Reolink
apps.notes: IP cameras and NVR systems

apps.name: eufy Security
apps.notes: Local-storage cameras and smart home devices by Anker

apps.name: Govee Home
apps.notes: LED strips and ambient lighting; newer lineup is Matter-certified

apps.name: SwitchBot
apps.notes: Retrofit physical switches, curtains, hubs; Matter via SwitchBot Hub 2

apps.name: Meross
apps.notes: Smart plugs and lighting; early Matter adopter

apps.name: Roborock
apps.notes: Premium robot vacuum line spun off from Xiaomi

apps.name: iRobot Home
apps.notes: Roomba robot vacuums; acquired by Amazon in 2023

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.notes: Open-source home automation; reference implementation for Matter integration

apps.name: Wemo
apps.notes: Belkin smart plugs; legacy Wi-Fi protocol (no Matter as of 2024)
